header.title: Describe how {organizationName} participates in the market.
header.body: Capabilities are organization claims until separate evidence and verification processes say otherwise. Industry codes, project history, and preferences remain supporting context.

assistance.title: Start in your own words
assistance.placeholder: For example: We inspect and repair commercial stormwater systems…
assistance.help: Assistance proposes catalog entries; it does not certify your organization or update discovery.
assistance.editHelp: Editing records your correction only. Select the correct current AMACS capability manually before saving a claim.

catalog.title: Browse Domain → Family → Capability
catalog.search: Search labels, aliases, definitions, and hierarchy

claim.title: Review the organization claim
claim.marketRole: Market role · select at least one
claim.serviceGeography: Service geography · select at least one
claim.boundaryBody: Saving creates a self-reported capability assertion. Evidence, verification, RFx qualification, and credibility remain separate.

confirmed.title: Confirmed organization claims
confirmed.emptyBody: Describe the organization in plain language or browse the complete AMACS catalog. The existing activation capability remains available during migration.

provisional.summary: None of the catalog terms fit
provisional.body: Submit an editorial proposal instead of forcing an inaccurate capability. It remains non-canonical and cannot satisfy matching requirements.
provisional.countOne: {count} provisional term is awaiting governed editorial review.
provisional.countMany: {count} provisional terms are awaiting governed editorial review.

industry.title: Industry and NAICS context
industry.body: Use these descriptors to explain markets served. They are not proof that the organization performs a capability.
industry.industries: Industries served · comma or line separated
industry.selectorBody: Select an exact six-digit industry from the {version} classification published by the {source}. Titles and versions cannot be entered manually.
industry.boundaryBody: NAICS and industry data do not establish capability, certification, eligibility, qualification, or procurement readiness.

experience.title: Add past performance
experience.body: Record bounded project context. Keep customer, contract, financial, and evidence details private unless publication is explicitly appropriate.
experience.disclose: Allow this value to be disclosed at the selected visibility
experience.outcomes: Outcomes claimed · comma or line separated
experience.related: Related confirmed capabilities · optional explicit review
experience.boundaryBody: This record does not award credibility or establish confirmed or independently verified experience.
experience.emptyBody: Add a bounded organization-authored project when it helps participants understand the organization’s work.

preferences.title: Teaming, referral, and resource preferences
preferences.body: Record how the organization would like to participate in future workflows. These statements are not permission, availability, commitment, endorsement, or a legal relationship.

notices.genericSaveError: Review the fields and try again.
notices.suggestionsReadyBody: These AMACS suggestions have no effect until you confirm one and save a separate organization claim.
notices.assistanceUnavailableBody: Browse or search the complete AMACS catalog below; the manual path remains available.
notices.confirmedBody: Review scope, roles, geography, and visibility below, then use Save organization claim. Confirmation alone did not change discovery.
notices.editedBody: The edit remains non-authoritative. Use the manual catalog path to select and review the correct current capability before saving an organization claim.
notices.nonAuthoritativeBody: This suggestion remains non-authoritative and cannot affect discovery or matching.
notices.dispositionErrorBody: Refresh and review the suggestion again.
notices.closedBody: None of these suggestions will affect your profile. Search manually or submit a provisional term.
notices.claimSavedBody: The organization-claimed AMACS capability is now available to permitted discovery. It is not independently verified.
notices.industrySavedBody: Industry and NAICS are descriptive context. They do not prove capability or procurement readiness.
notices.experienceSavedBody: The project is recorded as organization self-report. No confirmation, verification, qualification, or credibility was awarded.
notices.preferencesSavedBody: These preferences describe interests only. They do not grant permission, promise availability, or create a referral or teaming relationship.
notices.provisionalSavedBody: The proposal is queued as non-canonical editorial input. It cannot satisfy a canonical capability requirement.
